items.text: Online Leaderboards - The Masochist mode now includes a global leaderboards system where players can compete for speedrun records and challenge friends.
4-Player Co-op Unlocked - Co-0p Block 3 is now accessible from the start, offering four-player cooperative levels designed for party sessions with synchronized chaos and shared objectives.
Enhanced Customization - New emotes provide additional expression options, and a variable neck-length feature offers fine-tuned control.
Improved Onboarding - A dedicated help menu guides new players through game mechanics and answers common questions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817811/fff7e4ba87997e1921f15ffaa070be66773bf327.jpg"]

The camera system has been completely overhauled to eliminate jitter and deliver smooth gameplay. Geckos now animate dynamically, minigame scoring features satisfying confetti effects, hub orb deposits have enhanced VFX, and gnome deposit animations have been reworked. A helpful guide now identifies secret areas throughout the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817811/324295741f25d21086dcf767df20dc7ecde561c2.jpg"]

The game now features nearly 4,500 personally-recorded mouth-originated sound effects. New audio includes custom quips for gnomes, whales, chickens, Travneck, and hub harp orbs. Competitive minigame levels now showcase the game's signature jews-harp and banjo combo, with newly mixed tracks and balanced audio transitions throughout.

Major fixes include resolved gnome spawn behavior, corrected puzzle door mechanics, fixed minigame weapon contests, and eliminated flickering in neck mode switching. Level design has been reviewed and adjusted based on community feedback, layering issues have been corrected, and progress-critical objects now respawn reliably. Additional improvements include chained player mechanics fixes, build version display in the menu, and numbered level indicators in the hub world.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42817811/e715cea729796b5cd9c2c90a467befc511210546.jpg"]
Let us know what you think about the update, and good luck trying to beat our records in Masochist Mode!
Esophaguys Team - Peyton, Hendrik, Matt, Drain

releases.displayName: Esophaguys | Fixes and some Esophaball changes

items.text: Thanks for all your feedback from Friday, we've been working hard to get the fixes out to you. Which is exactly what this is about. We just pushed an update of our demo on Steam that you can go ahead and enjoy right away. Here's a quick list of the changes:
All the current Esophaball levels. Some received a pretty significant rework. Go try them out and let us know what you think. Most of it is based on what we saw in Fridays little tourney.
The Esophaball blowfish to have a max velocity of 200. No more blowfish go brrrrrrr.
The geckos not quite eating their fruits too accurately
Many issues with the player spawning systems. We identified about 4 cases where things went wrong, but it should be a lot more stable now.
Some invisible trees in some levels.
Character clothing sometimes clipping
Some characters wearing the same clothes.
Level ending doors not working
Character and Blowfish not respawning for certain Esophaball levels.
Still some cases where the Esophaball instruction panels refuse to fall down and start the countdown.
